general.description: The Corridor is a Pupeteers-run closed O'Neill habitat build between the 13-Planets and the Independant Stars. At first a small wheel-type outpost, it has then been discovered that it was linked to several other states by 3- to 5-jumps routes. Under impulse from the 13-Planets, the original outpost has been replaced by an extended terrarium-type habitat.
general.bar: Locals and visitors of all species and cultures make up a chattering, diverse crowd
